subject: Inconsistent detailing of the standpipe connection at Lobby 101 between Fire Sprinkler

messages.text: The standpipe connection shown in Fire Sprinkler Riser Diagram FP-501 at Lobby 101 isn't detailed consistently with Fire Protection Detail 3/FP502 -- need direction before we release the sprinkler shop drawings. We would like this closed out ahead of the underground flush and hydrostatic test. No cost impact is anticipated. This isn't holding up any current sprinkler work. There's no hard deadline on this, but a timely response is appreciated.

Layout the standpipe connection per Fire Protection Detail 3/FP502; disregard the conflicting note in Fire Sprinkler Riser Diagram FP-501. No cost impact is anticipated. This isn't holding up any current sprinkler work.
